notes.title: PROLOGUE - MAJOR UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1][b]Greetings, Bunker Enthusiasts! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]Thank you for your feedback regarding the free Prologue 🙌[/b][/h2]

We are thrilled to announce a significant update to Bunker Builder Simulator, introducing a [b]new Prologue version is NOW ready to download![/b]. As we mentioned in an earlier entry, the new update is now ready to play! 🤩 

This update brings substantial [b]improvements[/b] and [b]additions aimed[/b] at enhancing your gameplay experience. If that wasn’t enough, we’re [b]introducing a NEW tool[/b] and a [b]completely new feature[/b]! 🔥 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2148940/Bunker_Builder_Simulator_Prologue/

[h3][u]Below is a detailed overview of what the updates include[/u]:[/h3]

[h3]🎒 New Inventory System[/h3]
Manage your resources more effectively with our new inventory system. This feature allows for better organization and accessibility of materials, enabling you to focus more on building and less on juggling items.

[h3]📝 Revamped User Interface[/h3]
We've redesigned the user interface to be more intuitive and visually appealing. The new UI facilitates easier navigation and interaction, allowing you to better control the game and enjoy it more fully.

[h3]💪 Remastered Perk System[/h3]
The perk system has been completely remastered, offering more significant choices and benefits. Now, each selected perk can profoundly influence your gameplay style and bunker-building strategies.

[h3]👷 Added Excavator[/h3]
Dig deeper and faster with the newly added excavator. This powerful machine is designed to speed up excavations, enabling more efficient foundation creation for your bunkers.

[h3]🗺️ Improved Maps[/h3]
We have enhanced all our maps, improving details and textures to provide a more immersive environment. Explore and build with a renewed sense of place and possibility.

[h3]🔦 Addition of a Flashlight[/h3]
Navigate dark construction sites more easily with the newly added flashlight. This essential tool improves visibility, ensuring that no detail is overlooked, even in the lowest light conditions.

[h3]👀 Enhanced Graphics[/h3]
Graphics have been upgraded across the board to provide a more realistic and engaging visual experience. Enjoy sharper textures, dynamic lighting, and improved effects that bring your bunkers to life.

[h3]💰 Upgraded Contracts[/h3]
Contracts have been enriched with new challenges and requirements, making each task more engaging and satisfying. Strive to meet higher standards and earn greater rewards.

[h3]🤯 Numerous Bug Fixes[/h3]
In this update, we've eliminated numerous bugs, improving overall stability and performance. These fixes are based on community feedback and our own rigorous testing.

[h3]And Much More… 🤔[/h3]
The update also includes many other enhancements and modifications aimed at improving every aspect of the game.


We believe these updates will significantly improve your gameplay experience, add satisfaction and open up new possibilities within the game. We eagerly await your feedback, so please do not hesitate to share your thoughts and experiences. We also encourage you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/3bSvc8Byzh]Discord[/url] and become an active member of the Bunker Builder Community! 👍


[h3][b]The full game is coming soon 👀 so don't miss the premiere and add it to your Wishlist! 👇[/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1868210/Bunker_Builder_Simulator/


[url=https://discord.gg/3bSvc8Byzh][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/cf3ead71837cb9c1efe9c47c72eecf05335d8e6a.png[/img][/url]


Happy building!
Bunker Builder Simulator Team

notes.title: Latest Updates
notes.content:
[h1][b]Greetings, survival and strategy enthusiasts![/b][/h1]

We're thrilled to present the latest updates to Bunker Builder Simulator, our game that challenges you to tackle the complexities of building and managing bunkers under a variety of often unpredictable conditions. Here are three key updates that we're sure will enrich your virtual experiences:

[h3][b] 1. Updated Maps: New Models, Textures, and Diverse Locations [/b][/h3]
The first update concerns our maps. We want each location to be not only visually appealing but also to offer unique strategic challenges. We've introduced new models and textures that make the areas around your bunkers look much better and more varied. Now, each map features individual characteristics that can impact your design and strategic decisions, from dense forests to abandoned urban areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/c1369f3347259e15d90ff2d2720c7f0e540ccd90.gif[/img]
[h3][b]2. Remastered Skill System [/b][/h3]
Another significant change is to the skill system. After thorough analysis of feedback from you, our community, we decided to completely remodel this aspect of the game. The skill system is now more intuitive, offering a richer selection of development paths for your characters. The updated user interface makes navigation easier and allows for quicker decision-making regarding character development, from construction skills to survival techniques.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/494ca5a48c33ed24bb94bc88f18219820563eca3.png[/img]
[h3][b]3. Bunker Evaluation Cutscene[/b][/h3]
Finally, we're delighted to introduce a new feature: the bunker evaluation cutscene. After completing the construction of your shelter, the game will reward you with a specially prepared cutscene that not only summarizes your achievements but also showcases the results of your hard work in an attractive visual form. This beautiful cutscene is a great finale to each stage of the game, adding a sense of satisfaction and accomplishment.

We're immensely grateful for your support and engagement, which continue to motivate us to further develop Bunker Builder Simulator. We believe that these updates will further enrich your game experiences. We eagerly await your feedback and stories with the new features!

[url=https://discord.gg/3bSvc8Byzh][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/7a69c1480802ede236a9458e942f0895eaa6ba8a.png[/img][/url]

See you in the game,
The Bunker Builder Simulator Team

notes.title: New Mechanics
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players! 👋 [/b][/h1]

Welcome back to another devlog for our game, "Bunker Builder Simulator"! 🕳️
Today, we’re thrilled to introduce two entirely new and exciting mechanics that we're adding to enhance your gameplay experience.

[h3][b]Tablet-Controlled Excavator 👷[/b][/h3]
One of the new features we're implementing is the ability to use an excavator via a tablet. Upon clicking the appropriate icon on the tablet, you'll transition to a top-down view camera, allowing you to mark areas for excavation. This enhancement aims to expedite the digging process, enabling you to swiftly expand your bunker empire. Now, you can efficiently plan and execute construction tasks, all from the convenient viewpoint of your tablet screen!

[previewyoutube=fWZriVZ6Bxc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]New Power Connection System ⚡[/b][/h3]
The second innovative mechanic we're introducing is a brand-new power connection system. Instead of a simple click-and-connect method, you'll engage in a mini-game involving rotating fuses to create a connection between the starting point and endpoint. This more interactive way of connecting power requires precision and dexterity. Rotate the fuses to compose the perfect connection and ensure that your bunker has stable and secure electrical power.

[previewyoutube=fRi6490ib2c;full][/previewyoutube]
With the addition of these new mechanics, we aim not only to increase the game's dynamism but also to provide you with more engaging and satisfying challenges while building your bunkers. Thank you for your support and patience—your feedback and suggestions are incredibly valuable to us!

Stay tuned, as we'll soon share more updates and progress on the horizon. Until the next devlog!

[url=https://discord.gg/3MDM2G4PM2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/cf3ead71837cb9c1efe9c47c72eecf05335d8e6a.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1868210/Bunker_Builder_Simulator/ 

See you soon
Bunker Builder Team

notes.title: New Inventory System and City Center Maps
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello, bunker builders!👋[/b][/h1] 

We have some exciting updates for our game "Bunker Builder Simulator." Our team has been hard at work on introducing a new inventory system that brings new possibilities and challenges to your underground bunker adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/2c101c5ddbc4f895bb9978363b0320fd327c6d66.png[/img]
[h3][b]New Inventory System 🎒[/b][/h3]

The most significant addition is our freshly prepared inventory system. Now you can carry more items than ever before, but there's a catch - we've introduced a limit in the form of a weight system. Each item has its own weight, and your character has a limited carrying capacity. You'll need to plan carefully what you take with you because exceeding the limit will slow you down and make bunker construction more challenging.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/1757e166af572458ccf089aae7e5d1e6e081b529.png[/img]
[h3][b]Hotkeys under F1, F2, F3, F4 ⌨️[/b][/h3]

We've also added a hotkey feature, allowing for lightning-fast access to essential items. With a keystroke, you can instantly reach for necessary tools or materials, greatly simplifying and speeding up the building process.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/2b28e2aa934c74233152101dd6e64abf08a1d57f.png[/img]
[h3][b]New City Center Maps 🏙️[/b][/h3]

In addition to this, we've prepared new maps set in a beautiful city center. Now you can explore fascinating streets, large buildings, and urban squares, offering an entirely new challenge in the bunker building process. You'll need to adapt your strategies to the urban environment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/65c73190a60149e9f8acf71dab159297f22c7d41.png[/img]
We're thrilled to introduce these changes, and we're confident that the new inventory system and city center maps add a new dimension to the gameplay. [b]Your feedback and suggestions are highly valuable to us, so please share your thoughts on our discord and in the comments below![/b] 👇

[url=https://discord.gg/3bSvc8Byzh][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/cf3ead71837cb9c1efe9c47c72eecf05335d8e6a.png[/img][/url]

See you in the world of bunkers!
Bunker Builder Simulator Team

notes.title: Improvements
notes.content:
[h1][b]Greetings, bunker builders! 👋[/b][/h1]

We have some exciting updates to share that have made our game, Bunker Builder Simulator, even more engaging and satisfying. Let's dive into the details! 📝

[h3][b]1. Improved Perk System with a Fresh Look[/b][/h3]

[b]Our perk system has undergone a significant overhaul[/b]. Not only does it run smoother, but it also sports a modern and appealing design. This provides you with an even greater degree of control over your character's development in the game. 👍

[h3][b]2. Added Material Types (Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced, etc.)[/b][/h3]

Every bunker builder knows that the right materials are crucial for succeeding. [b]We're introducing various material types[/b] such as beginner, intermediate, advanced, and many more. Each type of material has its unique characteristics and costs, allowing for more detailed planning of your bunker. 🧱

[h3][b]3. Sandbox Mode with Save Functionality[/b][/h3]

We want you to have more freedom to explore and create your bunker. 🙂 Therefore, [b]we're introducing a sandbox mode [/b]🏖️ where you can build without constraints. What's more, [b]you now have the ability to save your progress in sandbox mode[/b], so you can return to your project at any time.

[h3][b]4. New Loading Screen[/b][/h3]

We understand that waiting for a game to load can be tedious. That's why [b]we've introduced a new, visually appealing loading screen[/b] that adds some style and surprise during game loading. 😲

[h3][b]5. More New Maps![/b][/h3]

We're expanding the world of the Bunker Builder Simulator! 🔥 We've added several new maps that offer diverse challenges and construction opportunities. You now have even more places to explore and discover. 🤩

[previewyoutube=tZFB02GRsGY;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for your support and dedication to enhancing our game. We hope these updates will make Bunker Builder Simulator even more captivating and satisfying. We eagerly await your feedback and suggestions to help us further refine the game.

notes.title: New Maps!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Bunker Builders! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h2]We’d love to share with you the new content in our Bunker Builder Simulator! 🤩 We’ve been working on a few exciting addons which will undoubtedly add more depth and challenges to the game! 👷[/h2]

[h3][b]New large maps! [/b][/h3]
We’re broadening our horizons! [b]We’ve decided to add new, huge maps with different kinds of buildings such as halls or sheds placed on them.[/b] 🏠 Now, you’ll have to build your bunkers inside those structures which will demand additional care, planning and creativity ✏️ to manage the space efficiently! Are you ready for the challenge?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/b49e5a2f6686372422422d9ce11a4c1fde755973.jpg[/img]

On those new maps, simply creating a bunker is not enough… [b]You’ll have to plan[/b] them on a strictly specified area, taking into consideration [b]different limitations such as space for the generator ⚡ air conditioning systems 💨[/b] and more. Keep in mind that a well-designed bunker is of utmost importance for survival! 📝

The bunker project will appear on the map to help you with planning out where to begin and end the digging and more! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/1999501f174868fe426b8d6e775280fe783efc79.jpg[/img]

[b]Understanding and effectively managing the ventilation and power supply systems is yet another challenge[/b] you’ll have to face while playing on the new maps. 🤯 [b]You’ll not only have to connect them but also configure them[/b] in order to ensure the safety and comfort of the bunkers you build. 👍

We hope the new functions bring tons of fun and make the gameplay even more enjoyable than before! [b]We can’t wait to hear your opinions and ideas[/b] about the development of the game so [b]make sure to join our discord [/b]👇, [b]add this game to your wishlists [/b]👇 and share them with us!

notes.title: New mechanics
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Bunker Builders! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]We are happy to be able to share the novelties we’ve been working on for the last month with you- our dear community! 🤩[/h3]

We’ve just put finishing touches to a few very interesting mechanics which hopefully, bring new exciting experiences and more fun to the game! 🎉

The first one we’d like to show you is [b]the wheelbarrow.[/b] 👷 We are fully aware that moving each item individually from one place to another may be both annoying and time consuming.  Therefore, we introduced the mechanic which felt the most appropriate. Thanks to the wheelbarrow, you’ll be able to transport a few items at the same time! That’s not all! We’ve also decided to give you a possibility to upgrade it! 💥 This way you’ll be able to put even more items inside which will speed up the construction of your bunkers even further!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/5a7cb8771fe634391e9e05e0bf0e25d8c5cea4f2.gif[/img]
Another novelty we’ve introduced in the new build is [b]the mechanic of opening cabinets![/b] 🤩 From now on you’ll be able to put different items inside them! This is not only going to add realism to the game but also help you organize the interior of your bunkers! 👏

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/368011cc51032717d6f3184e67600885f9d7bca9.gif[/img]
Putting new mechanics aside, we’ve also added [b]new pieces of furniture and equipment![/b] Considering keeping the proper hygiene inside the bunker, we’ve added a shower. We didn’t stop with just that! We’ve also added new drawers and cabinets which you can use to store your belongings! 👍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/fedecdacc2a6091dcb20e5ae024cbbbe4b2fbe4c.gif[/img]

notes.title: New mechanics
notes.content:
[h1][b]Greetings Builders! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h2]The management decided to donate your crew and brought you some [b]new means ⚒️ to make your work more advanced[/b]! Without further ado, let’s look into them. 🤩[/h2]

[h3]First of all, [b]welding[/b]. 🥽 An ability to weld is bound to become [b]a key skill[/b] because it allows you to[b] elevate the durability of your bunker’s structure[/b] to another level. 💪 The minigame allowing you to do so is about connecting the two metal elements with a welding arc you control. 🔥 This minigame [b]requires a steady hand and some precision[/b] to [b]achieve durable welds[/b] promising the [b]safety of your construction[/b].[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/1b85f92516bd3ca6cc12184288f351d0a4e2e856.gif[/img]

As you [b]progress through the game[/b], you’ll be able to [b]use more advanced welders[/b] which will undoubtedly [b]make your work easier and faster[/b]. 😀

[h3]Secondly, [b]the ventilation system[/b]. 💨 It goes without saying how important a proper ventilation is when locked underground. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/6a9b48ce8168bb18a0a439b155d0d313448b6302.gif[/img]

[b]Plan the layout and create a reliable system[/b] using [b]pipes, vents and other key components[/b]. Pay attention to[b] choose the correct shapes and rotation [/b]↩️ of objects, otherwise the airflow will be disturbed ❌.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/efc20f84768bbcc4200c52e79041b349a309cd44.gif[/img]

Keep in mind that [b]the more you progress[/b] into the game, [b]the more complex the air conditioning systems will become[/b]. 👷

[h3]The last element we’d like to showcase today is the electricity system. ⚡ No bunker can operate without the source of electricity to support all the systems and devices it has at its disposal. To secure the future of your construction, you’re required to place a generator and connect it to the socket with a switch placed inside the bunker. ✌️[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/c367ebdded501167b37eb0354bbee10057c561ac.gif[/img]

That’s it for today. [b]We are very happy to hear your ideas and suggestions[/b] about the contents of the game so [b]join our discord community 👇[/b] and let us know what else you would like to see added! [b]Add our game to your wishlist 👇[/b] to get notified about every further update!

[url=https://discord.gg/3bSvc8Byzh][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/cf3ead71837cb9c1efe9c47c72eecf05335d8e6a.png[/img][/url] 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1868210/Bunker_Builder_Simulator/ 

See you soon,
Bunker Builder Team

[h1]Hello Builders! 👷[/h1]

[h2]We hope you have a wonderful day, because right now we are going to make it even better! It’s time for a new devlog covering some of [b]the tools[/b] 🛠️ you’ll get to use in the game and more! 🤩
[/h2]

[h3]Today, we will talk about 2️⃣ of them, one being[b] the bench saw[/b]. It allows you to [b]cut boards[/b] into pieces 🪓 you need for your bunker. You can achieve this through completion of a [b]quick minigame[/b].[/h3]

[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/be3f7de4ff511d87647f8a31494552dc5f98365d.png[/img]

One of such examples is [b]the excavator[/b]. Later in the game you’ll get to [b]be its operator[/b]! 🤩[/h2]

notes.title: Handy Tools 🛠
notes.content:
[h1][b]To all Bunker Builders👷‍♂️[/b][/h1]

[h3]It’s been a long time since the last devlog but we have some developmental updates for you today.
Roll up your sleeves, grab some tools and [b]get ready to get your hands dirty[/b]🤲[/h3]

[h2][b]Hands🤘[/b][/h2]

Speaking of hands, it will be the most basic tool in the game. It will allow you to lift, drop and insert building elements into constructions.🧱


They will also serve as a way to get into building mode where we can plan out blueprints of our objects/constructs of our peaceful garden🥰

[h2][b]Shovel 🥄 (there is no shovel emoji :D )[/b][/h2]

[b]The digging mechanic lets us dig out a hole for our bunker.🕳[/b]

You can decide how much dirt you take onto your shovel and drop it off at the container or set it down next to the hole, ⏰[b]BUT BE CAREFUL[/b]⏰ digging out [b]TOO MUCH[/b] dirt or carelessly putting it wherever will be punished by a fee taken away📉 from the reward🤑 of the contract.📝
Screwdriver🔩(there really is not enough tool related emojis)
Screwdriver lets us get into the screwing the screws minigame (who woulda thunk) in which the player has to rotate in the screws at the right time.🔁

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/2e9cca42584400e79289f7ed3443427d73ff1cb5.png[/img]



[h2][b]Different constructions require different amounts of screws1️⃣2️⃣3️⃣4️⃣5️⃣6️⃣
Hammer🔨(time)[/b][/h2]
[b]Another tool that gets us to a minigame.🎮[/b]

In this one, we will have to hit the nails a couple of times in order to connect planks to each other to strengthen the shape into which cement will be poured in later🕑


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/3826f219f99d4ffa9fed47094b83676ddb627adf.png[/img]


[h2][b]Bucket🗑[/b][/h2]

After pouring out the cement from for example a cement mixer we can carry and pour it out into the aformentioned  shape of our future bunker with a handy bucket! 😮

notes.title: Devlog #3 - Tools
notes.content:
[h2][b]Dear entrepreneur![/b][/h2]

We hope you are all right in these uncertain times!  🌥️


To make your day better we have prepared a quick overlook of new tools you will be able to use in [b]Bunker Builder Simulator[/b]  🛠️
Bunkers are great, but they have to be built first. No matter what they will have to withstand, you will need the right tools to do it. So what will be waiting for your hands?  👐 


Let’s start with a shovel which is a basic tool you will use a lot. When you will need to dig a little deeper and the excavator won’t be able to deal with more delicate work a shovel will be the tool you will need. 



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/94c3e384eaba1715d0a8ccc55bfc33fb25514a7f.png[/img]



When you create the metal skeleton of your bunker, you will feel more comfortable with a welder. It will help you get the job done quickly and precisely! Be careful as sloppy joints will weaken the structure of your bunkers.  ‼️

There will also be tools in the game that will make the interior of your bunker feel more like home. A paint roller or putty will help you decorate and smooth the walls of your bunker. A screwdriver will come in handy when you want to put new shelves on the walls. 👷‍♂️


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/9149b948336994d21d8387ab7c0c08abde31125a.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog#1 - A vision of game
notes.content:
Hello!

First of all we would like to thank you for your response to our previous post. You have a lot of questions about the gameplay, mechanics, and player agency in our game, which we appretiate very much.



Today we would like to share the [b]vision for our game[/b] with you.

As you well know the game will allow construction of bunkers for different clients. You will be able to contact those clients via the computer in your in-game office. Of course the mechanic regarding client interaction will require a separate devlog ;).
After accepting a contract you will be transported to you client's property in order to complete the job!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/bf52d71468f8e2118f57a256a6785e4457352596.png[/img]

In order to properly build our bunker we will have complete various tasks from the list - from preparing the foundations, or constructing a scaffolding, to completely designing the interiors.

While working you will have to take care to complete special demands and instructions your clients might have, as well as adhere to official safety norms like:

[b]- patching up holes in walls
- embanking exterior walls in earth up to the height of the ceilling
- sealing (hermetization) of the bunker
- installing bunker equipment (ventilation systems, power generators, valves)
- stocking up different rooms with appropriate supplies[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/a2ba6eee800780269f1d93da7232d6ece1b47872.png[/img]


Of course you will have a range of machines and tools to help you make the whole process more efficient. 🙂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/9149b948336994d21d8387ab7c0c08abde31125a.png[/img]






We're sure you have a lot of questions regarding the information we provided in this devlog - so don't hesitate to reach out to us! We want our game to meet all of your expectations, so your ideas and opinions are extremely useful to us.


[url=ZAPROSZENIE][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41779325/5db1e7f1a70edeabe7b65aab4c0a43ec23930458.png[/img][/url]
We also encourage you to join our Discord: https://discord.gg/3bSvc8Byzh


We wish you all the best!
